“我跟你一起！”王春晓想也不想，连忙开口道。

不知道为什么，王春晓觉得还是和李青山待在一起更安全一些，若是在趟子房内，那群野狼又来了怎么办？

昨天晚上，趟子房没有被这群野狼挠破。

却不代表今天不会被挠破，届时只要挤进来一只野狼，自己可就死定了。

李青山见状，便带着王春晓和大黄朝着旁边的小溪赶了过去。

附近有野狼，这是肯定的。

但不能因为有野狼，自己就不去狩猎了。

整个老林子里面，野狼多了去，甚至还有黑瞎子，运气不好的情况下还能遇到老虎，山君！！

黑夜的时候，野狼正是兴奋和狩猎的好时机。

但是白天。

李青山的视线不再受阻，遇到野狼只要迅速上树，手中的弓箭也未尝不利，毕竟还有大黄这个低头香，野狼在附近的话，必然会率先发现。

小溪旁。

清澈的溪水流淌，因为昨日下雨的原因，今日溪水的流量大上了许多，中间的位置甚至没过了大腿，平日里是只到脚腕上面一点点的。

因为昨日下雨的原因，今日老林子内的空气。

也尤为清新。

一夜的大雨，不少林蛙，蛤蟆出没，到处都是这些玩意，无论是林蛙还是蛤蟆，都有一定的价值，不过这些东西太过于分散，不太好抓。

刚顺着小溪没走两分钟，便感觉胸口的玉葫芦玉佩，微微发热，根据李青山这两日的经验，必然是有猎物送上门来了，赶路的脚步轻上了许多。

果然。

前方的小溪处，一只浑身羽毛花色艳丽的山鸡，嘴巴正叼着另外一只花色灰黄色野鸡脖颈后面的羽毛，肥硕的身体站在母野鸡的背上……！

相互之间正在纠缠！

时不时发出一声声鸡叫和扑腾声。

“李青山你看，那两只山鸡正在打架。”王春晓站在旁边，小声的指着前方小溪边的野鸡兴奋道：“不过，这么远，能打中吗？”

这还是王春晓第一次见识打猎，心中亢奋无比。

“能打中！”

“不过，这个时候出手，有点不道德！”

李青山望着前面的两只野鸡，陷入了沉思，作为一个男人，总觉得这个时候出手。

真的不太好。

“不道德？”

“为什么啊？”

王春晓微微一怔，脸上闪过一抹疑惑之色，一双眸子满是好奇的盯着李青山问道。

“人家正在为下一代做努力，我要是在这个时候一箭把他婆娘，或者男人给射死了，是不是有些不太道德？”

李青山看向一侧的王春晓，开口问道。

为下一代做努力？

“唰……！”

话音落下，便见王春晓的小脸瞬间升起一抹红晕，哪里还会不知道前面这两只山鸡在做什么。

想到刚刚自己说，这两只野鸡在打架。

王春晓便有些尴尬。

四目相对。

二人的距离尚且紧贴，王春晓甚至能够感受到李青山粗重的喘息，那阳刚之气的糙汉气息扑面而来，令女人浑身一阵发软。

老林子内的气氛有些诡异。

望着似乎越来越近的李青山，王春晓发软颤栗的身子，缓缓闭上了双眼，似乎在等待着什么。

“嗖……！”

就在这时。

一道破空声响起，旁边传来李青山惊喜的声音道：“射中了！”

“啊……！”

王春晓睁开眼，望着李青山冲出去的背影，心中忍不住升起一抹失落和委屈。

“哼……！”

娇嗔一声。

紧紧跟在李青山身后也追了出去。

臭男人。

真是什么都不懂，榆木疙瘩脑袋……！

气死了，气死了……！

李青山感受到身后王春晓的情绪变化，心中早就跟明镜一样，欲擒故纵，才能让鱼儿上钩更深，暧昧期相比于恋爱，更值得让人回味。

上一世。

李青山便明白一个道理，若是一个人结婚，在各方压迫和约束下，就只能有一个女人。

一个人若是谈恋爱了，在道德的约束下，也只能由一个女人。

自己要是光棍汉，也没有谈恋爱的话。

世界是自己的。

“一箭射中两只？”

王春晓跟过去后，望着被李青山一箭洞穿的两只野鸡，小脸上闪过一抹惊讶道。

“常规操作！”

李青山说罢，便手脚麻利的将这两只山鸡处理干净。

“李青山，这两只山鸡我拿着吧！”王春晓主动请缨道。

“好！”

李青山点头，将两只一共五斤多重的山鸡递给了王春晓，便顺着小溪继续朝着下游走去。

五分钟后。

“嗖！！”

一根长箭飞出，正中前方的一只花面狸。

“哇……！”

“这么准啊？”

王春晓一声惊叹，前面的花面狸隐藏在一处草丛内，站在自己这个位置都快要看不到了。

可就是这样，李青山还是一箭命中。

"I'm coming with you!" Wang Chunxiao said quickly without thinking.

For some reason, Wang Chunxiao felt that it was safer to stay with Li Qingshan. What if the pack of wild wolves came again in the house?

Last night, the house was not scratched by these wild wolves.

But it doesn't mean that he won't be scratched today. If a wild wolf squeezes in, he will be dead.

When Li Qingshan saw this, he led Wang Chunxiao and Dahuang towards the creek next to them.

There are wild wolves around, that's for sure.

But just because there are wild wolves, you can’t stop hunting.

In the entire old forest, there are many wild wolves, and even black blind men. If you are unlucky, you can encounter tigers and tigers!!

The dark night is a great time for wild wolves to get excited and hunt.

But during the day.

Li Qingshan's line of sight is no longer blocked. If he encounters a wild wolf, he can quickly climb up the tree, and the bow and arrow in his hand will not be disadvantageous. After all, there is rhubarb, a scent that lowers his head. If the wild wolf is nearby, he will definitely be the first to find it.

Beside the creek.

The clear stream flows. Because of yesterday's rain, the flow of the stream is much greater today. The middle part even reaches the thigh. Normally it only reaches a little above the ankle.

Because of the rain yesterday, the air in the old forest today is different.

It’s also particularly refreshing.

After a night of heavy rain, many forest frogs and toads appeared. These things were everywhere. Whether they were forest frogs or toads, they all had a certain value, but these things were too scattered and difficult to catch.

He had just walked along the stream for two minutes when he felt the jade gourd and jade pendant on his chest feel slightly warm. Based on Li Qingshan's experience in the past two days, prey must have been delivered to his door, so he walked much lighter.

really.

At the creek ahead, a pheasant with brightly colored feathers is holding the feathers on the back of the neck of another gray-yellow pheasant in its beak. Its plump body is standing on the back of the female pheasant...!

They are entangled with each other!

From time to time, a chicken crows and flapping.

"Li Qingshan, look, those two pheasants are fighting." Wang Chunxiao stood nearby, pointing quietly at the pheasant by the stream in front of him and said excitedly: "But, can you hit it from such a distance?"

This was Wang Chunxiao's first time seeing hunting, and he was extremely excited.

"It can hit!"

"However, it is a bit unethical to take action at this time!"

Li Qingshan looked at the two pheasants in front of him and fell into deep thought. As a man, he always felt that this was the time to take action.

Not really good.

"Immoral?"

"Why?"

Wang Chunxiao was slightly startled, a look of doubt flashed across his face, and he stared at Li Qingshan curiously and asked.

"People are working hard for the next generation. If I shoot his wife or man to death with an arrow at this time, wouldn't it be a bit immoral?"

Li Qingshan looked at Wang Chunxiao on one side and asked.

Working hard for the next generation?

"Shua...!"

As soon as he finished speaking, Wang Chunxiao's little face suddenly blushed, and he didn't know what the two pheasants in front of him were doing.

Thinking of what I just said, these two pheasants were fighting.

Wang Chunxiao felt a little embarrassed.

Eyes facing each other.

The distance between the two was still close, and Wang Chunxiao could even feel Li Qingshan's heavy breathing, and the masculine and rough man's breath hit his face, making the woman's whole body feel weak.

The atmosphere in the old forest was a bit strange.

Looking at Li Qingshan who seemed to be getting closer and closer, Wang Chunxiao's trembling body slowly closed his eyes, as if waiting for something.

"Whoosh...!"

Just then.

A sound broke through the air, and Li Qingshan's surprised voice came from the side: "Hit!"

"Ah...!"

Wang Chunxiao opened his eyes and looked at Li Qingshan's rushing figure. He couldn't help but feel a sense of loss and grievance in his heart.

"Hmph...!"

He let out a whimper.

He followed closely behind Li Qingshan and chased after him.

Stinky man.

You really don’t understand anything, you have a lumpy head...!

So angry, so angry...!

Li Qingshan felt Wang Chunxiao's emotional changes behind him, and he had long been like Ming Jing in his heart. Only by playing hard to get can the fish be hooked deeper. Compared with love, the ambiguous period is more worth remembering.

Previous life.

Li Qingshan understood the truth. If a person gets married, under the oppression and restrictions of all parties, there can only be one woman.

If a person falls in love, under the constraints of morality, it can only be with a woman.

If you are a bachelor and have not fallen in love.

The world is your own.

"Hit two with one arrow?"

After Wang Chunxiao followed, he looked at the two pheasants that were pierced by Li Qingshan's arrows, with a flash of surprise on his face.

"Routine operation!"

After Li Qingshan finished speaking, he quickly handled the two pheasants.

"Li Qingshan, let me take these two pheasants!" Wang Chunxiao volunteered.

"Okay!"

Li Qingshan nodded, handed two pheasants weighing more than five kilograms in total to Wang Chunxiao, and continued walking downstream along the stream.

Five minutes later.

"Whoosh!!"

A long arrow flew out and hit a masked civet in front of him.

"Wow...!"

"Is it so accurate?"

Wang Chunxiao exclaimed. The masked civet in front of him was hidden in the grass, and he could hardly see it from his position.

But even so, Li Qingshan still hit the target with one arrow.
